hook: Hyderabad RWAs push *mandatory* rainwater harvesting in every building
hook_b: Hyderabad RWAs push *mandatory* rainwater harvesting in every building
tldr: Hyderabad resident welfare associations called for mandatory rainwater harvesting, groundwater recharge and lake restoration at a national RWA conference in Ernakulam.

beats.what: Groups from Malkajgiri, Alwal, Kukatpally, Tellapur and HITEC City took part in the 13th National Conference of RWAs, organised by CoRWA.
beats.why: Water scarcity, and the chance of it worsening under El Nino conditions, was a key concern raised by Telangana RWAs.
beats.care: Other asks: quick-response teams for roads, sewage and streetlights, monthly RWA meetings with officials, and RWA seats in disaster committees.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: RWAs were urged to run water audits, fix leaks and reuse treated wastewater for gardening.

cards.q: Does your building have rainwater harvesting?

qs: Who would check that rainwater pits in old buildings actually work?
Would residents pay for retrofitting RWH structures?

facts.t: *Five* Hyderabad groups, from Malkajgiri to Tellapur, joined the delegation.

viz.l: Share of civic performance grants RWAs want for their priorities
viz.verdict: A proposal only; states must decide

learn.t: RWH = rainwater harvesting: catching rain and sending it into pits or wells to recharge groundwater

watch: CoRWA says final resolutions will be taken to states for implementation.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: Build RWH pits, restore lakes to tackle water woes: RWAs

fact: *Five* Hyderabad resident groups demand mandatory rainwater harvesting in all buildings
twist: They also want *20%* of civic performance grants spent on RWA-picked priorities.
